nd you’re describing exactly the right model:

Older OS branches produce deltas

Deltas often represent good intent that must be forward-ported into the newest line

Applying them “as-is” is risky because the base has moved

So the correct MetaBlooms rule is:
Delta = intent spec, not a byte-perfect patch
We ingest anything useful from the delta, translate it to the current OS structure, and ship a new full bundle with receipts.
To make that deterministic, I added a Delta Intake & Forward-"
